title: 第十六章 古武
content_zh:
王艺看着陈木一瞬间就将自己身边的小弟全部干倒了，顿时有点不知所措，他没想到陈木竟然这么能打。

    “王艺，我今天来这里跟你见面，不是为了跟你打架，我也没那个闲工夫，我来这里就是通知你一件事，以后离苏林依远点。”说着陈木也不管呆在那里的王艺，招呼了一声余北边走了，对于王艺这种小人物，陈木根本提不起兴趣，反正已经提醒了王艺，如果他在继续对苏林依使用卑鄙手段，陈木不介意让王艺永远消失。

    看着陈木跟余北安然无恙的离开，王艺脸色立刻变得有些阴沉，他没想到这陈木本事还不小，不过看他没有动手动自己，应该是怕自己了。王艺不知道的是，陈木不是怕他，而是根本没有看得起他。

    只不过让王艺有些疑惑的是，苏林依跟陈木到底是什么关系，陈木为什么要帮苏林依，思索了一会，王艺突然想到早上陈木叫苏林依叫小姐！

    “原来他就是苏本请的保镖！哼，虽然你做保镖跟我王艺没关系，但你却一直妨碍我追苏林依，所以也不能怪我心狠了！”王艺拿出电话，不知道打给谁

    ……

    “木头，不，老大，你什么变得什么厉害！”余北今天像是第一天认识陈木一般，兴奋的跟在陈木身后，没想到自己也有这么解气的一天，虽然最后没有对王艺怎么样，不过王艺的那些手下直接被陈木打的七零八落！

    “呵，很多事你不知道罢了。”陈木摇了摇头，笑道。

    余北听到陈木这般说话，也没有再说什么，便先行离开去教室等陈木了。

    苏林依跟孙依诗来到天台下面观战的时候，只看到王艺以及他的那些躺在地上哀嚎的狗腿子们。

    “依依姐，没想到陈木挺厉害的啊，这么多人都被打的七零八落。”孙依诗有些惊讶道

    “哼！打架厉害有什么好的，打架这种事都是那些小混混干的！”苏林依皱了皱眉，否认道，她可不想承认陈木，不然孙依诗还以为她以为接受陈木当她的跟班了。苏林依自然是不接受陈木的，突然来了一个陌生人，而且是一个男人，恐怕任何一个女生都会不习惯，甚至厌恶。
content_en:
Wang Yi saw Chen Mu knocking down all the boys around him in an instant, and was a little overwhelmed. He didn't expect Chen Mu to be so good at fighting.

"Wang Yi, I'm not here to meet you today to fight with you. I don't have the time to spare. I'm here to tell you something. Stay away from Su Linyi from now on." After saying that, Chen Mu ignored Wang Yi who was staying there and said hello to Yu Beibian. Chen Mu had no interest in a small person like Wang Yi. Anyway, Wang Yi had been reminded that if he continued to use despicable methods against Su Linyi, Chen Mu would not mind letting Wang Yi disappear forever.

Seeing Chen Mu and Yu Bei leaving safely, Wang Yi's face immediately turned gloomy. He didn't expect that Chen Mu was quite capable, but seeing that he didn't touch him, he must be afraid of himself.What Wang Yi didn't know was that Chen Mu was not afraid of him, but didn't think highly of him at all.

But what made Wang Yi a little confused was what the relationship between Su Linyi and Chen Mu was, and why Chen Mu wanted to help Su Linyi. After thinking for a while, Wang Yi suddenly thought of Chen Mu calling Su Linyi Miss this morning!

"It turns out that he is the bodyguard hired by Su Ben! Huh, although you have nothing to do with me as a bodyguard, Wang Yi, but you have been hindering me from chasing Su Linyi, so you can't blame me for being cruel!" Wang Yi took out the phone and didn't know who to call.

…

"Mu Mu, no, boss, you have become so powerful!" Yu Bei followed Chen Mu excitedly as if he had met Chen Mu for the first time today. He didn't expect that he would have such a day of relief. Although he didn't do anything to Wang Yi in the end, Wang Yi's men were beaten to pieces by Chen Mu!

"Oh, you just don't know a lot of things." Chen Mu shook his head and smiled.

When Yu Bei heard Chen Mu talking like this, he didn't say anything else, so he left first and went to the classroom to wait for Chen Mu.

When Su Linyi and Sun Yishi came to the rooftop to watch the battle, they only saw Wang Yi and his henchmen lying on the ground and wailing.

"Sister Yiyi, I didn't expect Chen Mu to be very powerful. So many people were beaten to pieces." Sun Yishi said in surprise.

"Hmph! What's so good about being good at fighting? Fighting is all done by those gangsters!" Su Linyi frowned and denied that she didn't want to admit Chen Mu, otherwise Sun Yishi would think that she accepted Chen Mu as her follower.Su Linyi naturally did not accept Chen Mu. Suddenly a stranger came, and he was a man. I am afraid that any girl would not be used to it, or even disgusted.
